import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 11, "text.color": "#263238", "axes.labelcolor": "#263238", "axes.edgecolor": "#263238", "xtick.color": "#657786", "ytick.color": "#657786", "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.linewidth": 1.0, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "none", })
blue = "#33658A" teal = "#2A9D8F" ochre = "#D4A72C" orchid = "#9273B5" slate = "#657786" ink = "#263238" sample_colors = [blue, teal, ochre, orchid]
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.8, 4.0), facecolor="white")
# Continuous function and the four exact, uniformly spaced samples. ax = fig.add_axes([0.075, 0.225, 0.405, 0.575]) t = np.linspace(0.0, 4.0, 1200, endpoint=False) n = np.arange(4) values = np.array([1.0, 0.0, -1.0, 0.0])
ax.plot(t, np.cos(2 * np.pi * t / 4), color=blue, lw=2.2, zorder=2) ax.axhline(0, color="#DDE3E5", lw=0.9, zorder=0)
# Dashed guides start at the lower horizontal axis, so zero-valued # samples also have visible stems without changing their values. for ti, yi, color in zip(n, values, sample_colors): ax.plot([ti, ti], [-1.2, yi], color=color, lw=1.2, linestyle=(0, (3, 3)), alpha=0.8, zorder=1, clip_on=False) ax.scatter(ti, yi, s=66, color=color, edgecolors="white", linewidths=1.1, zorder=4, clip_on=False)
# The excluded endpoint is represented by an open circle. ax.scatter([4], [1], s=45, facecolors="white", edgecolors=blue, linewidths=1.4, zorder=3, clip_on=False)
ax.set_xlim(0, 4) ax.set_ylim(-1.2, 1.2) ax.set_xticks([0, 1, 2, 3, 4]) ax.set_yticks([-1, 0, 1]) ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=10, length=4, width=0.9, pad=5) ax.set_xlabel(r"$t$ (dimensionless)", labelpad=9) ax.set_ylabel(r"$f(t)$", labelpad=10) ax.spines["left"].set_color(slate) ax.spines["bottom"].set_color(slate)
fig.text(0.075, 0.925, "Continuous function", fontsize=14, weight="semibold") fig.text(0.075, 0.850, r"$f(t)=\cos(2\pi t/4),\quad 0\leq t<4$", fontsize=13) fig.text(0.075, 0.065, "Filled points: samples · Open point: excluded endpoint", fontsize=9, color=slate)
# Transformation arrow, kept separate from both scientific panels. mid = fig.add_axes([0.495, 0.24, 0.245, 0.56]) mid.set_axis_off() mid.text(0.5, 0.70, "Uniform sampling", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11.5, color=ink) mid.text(0.5, 0.58, r"at $t=n$ $(N=4)$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11.5, color=ink) mid.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (0.10, 0.39), (0.90, 0.39), arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=22, linewidth=1.8, color=slate, )) mid.text(0.5, 0.20, r"$v_n=f(n)$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12, color=slate)
# Explicit four-dimensional column vector and matching sample indices. fig.text(0.765, 0.925, "Discrete vector", fontsize=14, weight="semibold") vec = fig.add_axes([0.755, 0.22, 0.23, 0.59]) vec.set_axis_off() vec.set_xlim(0, 1) vec.set_ylim(0, 1) vec.text(0.045, 0.50, r"$\mathbf{v}=$", fontsize=20, ha="left", va="center")
left, right = 0.35, 0.66 bottom, top = 0.14, 0.86 cap = 0.045 vec.plot([left + cap, left, left, left + cap], [top, top, bottom, bottom], color=ink, lw=1.6) vec.plot([right - cap, right, right, right - cap], [top, top, bottom, bottom], color=ink, lw=1.6)
row_y = [0.77, 0.59, 0.41, 0.23] for i, (value, y, color) in enumerate(zip(values, row_y, sample_colors)): vec.text(0.505, y, rf"${int(value)}$", fontsize=21, ha="center", va="center", color=color) vec.text(0.77, y, rf"$n={i}$", fontsize=11, ha="left", va="center", color=slate)
fig.text(0.765, 0.115, r"$\mathbf{v}\in\mathbb{R}^{4}$", fontsize=12, color=slate)
